image.promptSummary: Remove ONLY the solid black outer background of the supplied red neon AutoFinalRobo2 robot logo; preserve the robot, dark inner surfaces, red/white linework, wheels, eyes, boards and proportions; transparent alpha, no text or container.
image.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied AutoFinalRobo2 red neon robot logo. Primary request: remove ONLY the solid black outer background, leaving the exact robot logo isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background for a web navbar and startup splash. Preserve the red neon linework, small white/red highlights, four wheels, ultrasonic eyes, boards, proportions, camera angle, composition and all mechanical details exactly. Keep the black/dark surfaces INSIDE the robot, cut out only the surrounding backdrop and empty spaces between components. No redesign, no recoloring, no new text or objects, no surrounding container, no shadow outside the robot. Crisp edges, maintain the soft red glow around the edge without an opaque black rectangle. Asset type: transparent PNG logo derivative; keep the original unchanged.

notificationPlacement: bottom-right explicitly on desktop/mobile, lower safe areas; replaces header measurement
